body: on the back: “before thursday lunch, a greasy sheen in the cab after the greenhouse test. my wrists blistered. later, the telephone line died.”
title: cab note — before thursday lunch
gloss: A personal field trace precedes the visible emergency response.
rival_reading: Responders could have collected the a greasy sheen while crossing treated land; the note or objects do not prove the program began the emergency.

title: A count after gunfire
body: I helped move the injured away from the barrier. Later an officer asked for the number of cars, not the number of people. He drew a fresh line under his total while two families were still behind the disabled van.
rival_reading: The agricultural trial may have caused the disorder that forced improvised decisions.
gloss: A witness records a failed evacuation count or route.
